description: This file defines an abstract interface for a Netlink client and a factory for creating such clients within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It declares the NetlinkClient class with a pure virtual Send method, and the NetlinkClientFactory class with a method to create new clients and a static method to get the default factory instance.

classes.name: NetlinkClient
classes.description: Abstract class representing a Netlink client with a method to send messages.

classes.name: NetlinkClientFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating NetlinkClient instances, with a static method to get the default factory.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send a NetlinkRequest message to the kernel.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new NetlinkClient instance of a specified type.
